text:
Anna Chen: Quick sync — we need final gating criteria for the next DP cohort so we can send invites by Wed. Can we lock the checklist by EOD?

Mike R: I can own the eligibility boolean and invite list. What are the hard blockers?

Anna Chen: Hard blockers = data class (no PII), baseline traffic (>=50 API calls/day), and an instrumented feedback pipeline (session ids + eval hooks). Everything else is negotiable.

Sahil K: Agree on the instrumentation. For the feedback pipeline we need: sample prompts, latency metrics, and automated quality labels. Prefer to test with a small synthetic workload first.

Jules: For synthetic workload — can we get a 1-week run that mimics 60/40 short/long prompts? ops can spin up a dedicated test slot.

ops-bot: scheduled: test-slot-redwood-dp-5 created for 3 days starting 1767655000.

Priya N: We also need the success criteria spelled out for partners: engagement thresholds, regression tolerance, and exit triggers. Suggested: >=70% weekly response rate, no more than one >2x latency spike per week, and no model-regression >5% on our eval set.

Mike R: That sounds reasonable. Can we define "response rate" precisely? Is it % of invites who run at least one end-to-end session?

Anna Chen: Yes — response rate = % invited partners who complete >=1 instrumented session within 14 days.

Sahil K: On regression metric — we'll run per-prompt BLEU-ish plus human pass/fail on 200 golden prompts. If any daily drift >5% for three consecutive days -> alert + canary rollback.

Jules: For QA handoff: product will provide the prompt suite, eng will provide the evaluation harness, and partners will tag sessions with "dp_tag": true so we can pull traces. Quick snippet for tagging that we can share with partners:

```json
{"session_metadata": {"dp_tag": true, "partner_id": "<ID>", "cohort": "spring-2026"}}
```

Priya N: Also need the incentive plan in writing. Last time gift cards were messy. Proposal: $1k credit + advisory call + case study option. Thoughts?

Mike R: $1k credit + optional case study is fine. Need legal to approve case study consent text.

Anna Chen: I'll draft the consent blurb. Also, recruitment pipeline: prioritize partners with existing infra and a dedicated PM/Eng contact. No cold startups with single founder.

Sahil K: We should add a technical gating checklist for non-engineer contacts: must have CORS-enabled endpoint or proxy, and be able to drop in our JS snippet in <48h.

Jules: Timeline check — invites Wed, 1-week synthetic smoke, then 4-week live trial. Graduation decision 2 weeks after live trial ends. Does that fit ops capacity?

ops-bot: capacity: 6 active DP slots available during proposed window.

Anna Chen: Perfect. Last ask — who will own the daily triage during the live trial?

Mike R: I'll rotate with Sahil for first two weeks; product will own partner comms.

Sahil K: I'll prepare the eval dashboard and wire up alerting to #eng-oncall.

Priya N: I'll finalize incentive copy and share with legal by EOD.

Anna Chen: Great — action items: Mike: invite list + eligibility boolean. Sahil: eval harness + dashboard. Jules/ops: test slot & capacity. Priya: incentives + legal. I'll send invite template and consent blurb in this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Mike R: ack

Sahil K: ack

Jules: ack

Priya N: ack
